subject.title: fix: skip pushLoopFailure for MidTurnPrecheckSignal control-flow errors

question: Should agent-core accept a generic control-flow error contract for this mid-turn recovery path, or should `MidTurnPrecheckSignal` stay entirely owned by the embedded runner?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the PR's hidden `Symbol.for` sentinel changes reusable agent-core failure semantics and conflicts with the current `transformContext` no-throw contract unless maintainers approve that boundary.

options.title: Narrow or formalize before merge
options.body: Require the PR to remove the OpenClaw-specific hidden sentinel from agent-core, or replace it with an explicit generic control-flow option and contract tests.

options.title: Accept the hidden sentinel
options.body: Allow the current core boundary shape after the type errors are fixed and live proof shows the user-visible leak is gone.

options.title: Use the broader candidate PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99435 as the canonical path only if it is updated with proof, tests, and a viable maintainer-approved boundary.

recommendation.title: Narrow or formalize before merge
recommendation.body: Require the PR to remove the OpenClaw-specific hidden sentinel from agent-core, or replace it with an explicit generic control-flow option and contract tests.
